articles.title: Trump and Venezuela’s Elusive Elections
articles.summary: When will Venezuela hold elections? More than nine months after the capture and extraction of the country’s strongman, Nicolás Maduro in a military raid ordered by President Donald Trump, there are still no clear answers . On Oct. 27, María Corina Machado, the country’s most prominent opposition leader, returned to Caracas after about a year in exile, thanked the Trump Administration for removing Maduro, and expressed faith that an election would be held in Venezuela in 2027. articles.title: How to Relieve Sciatica Pain—and What Makes It Worse
articles.summary: Sciatica can send pain shooting down your leg and make it hard to find a comfortable way to sit, stand, or sleep. Finding relief starts with figuring out what’s irritating the nerve . A herniated disc, a spinal canal that’s become too narrow and puts pressure on the nerves, and other problems can cause the pain—and what helps one person may make another feel worse. articles.title: How to Try Somatic Shaking for Stress Relief
articles.summary: Imagine you’ve just washed your hands, and there’s no towel. Give them a gentle shake, and then let your arms join in. That’s the start of a stress-management exercise that may help loosen your tense muscles and give you a break from anxious thoughts , says Kim Penberthy, a clinical psychologist and professor of research in psychiatric medicine at the UVA School of Medicine.
